dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid linear convergence from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a narrow, pointed termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Slight convex bulge on the left lateral margin relative to the right; otherwise smooth and symmetrical edge transitions.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey across the entirety of the visible dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High density of ring-shaped tonal variations distributed across the mid-dorsal and anterior-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, well-defined gradient edges between the circular epidermal patterns and the primary dark-grey skin baseline.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Numerous distinct circular and overlapping ring-shaped marks with darker perimeters and slightly lighter centers.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible raised longitudinal ridge along the central axis; no significant concave traumatic indentations observed.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of ring-like epidermal markings/lesions concentrated on the central dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique geometric ring-shaped clusters covering a significant portion of the mid-dorsal region.
